method: Independent NumPy confusion matrices, Macro-F1, accuracy and per-example NLL; no package summary function, fitting, inference, selection or access to official test labels.

core_clock.scope: Controller active run time; setup/smoke excluded; epoch-boundary stop can overrun by an epoch.

aggregation_scope: Fixed reused validation split; three paired seeds. SD is descriptive; no population CI or significance claim.

primary.definition: C4 minus C0, mean of three paired fixed-seed Macro-F1 scores

uncertainty.scope: Prospectively locked project-unused same-source license-cohort audit. Conditional component-sampling intervals for six fixed models; no seed-population, IID/external-data, multiplicity-adjusted or deployment guarantee.
